proofs.text: Run `--all --quick` over a project whose test carries a marker and whose plugin is not loaded; verify exit 1 and the line `the pytest arm ran and its plugin wrote no proof entry`, naming `1 marked test(s)`. Run the same project with no marker anywhere; verify `wrote no proof entry` is absent, the table reads `Drafted 1` and the run exits 0

rule_text: An arm that ran while its framework's markers sit in the tree, and whose plugin appended no entry at all, exits the run 1 and names that framework and how many marked tests were found; an arm with no markers is silent and not a failure

tests.body:
def test_an_arm_that_wrote_nothing_is_named(self, tmp_path):
        # The markers are in the tree and the plugin is not loaded: pytest
        # passes, and nothing at all is written. This is the failure the test
        # framework itself reports as success.
        root = _project(tmp_path)
        _spec(root, 'feat')
        (root / 'tests').mkdir()
        (root / 'tests' / 'test_feat.py').write_text(
            'import pytest\n\n'
            '@pytest.mark.proof("feat", "PROOF-1", "RULE-1")\n'
            'def test_ok():\n'
            '    assert True\n', encoding='utf-8')
        code, output = _run(root, '--all', '--quick')
        assert code == 1, output
        assert 'the pytest arm ran and its plugin wrote no proof entry' in output
        assert '1 marked test(s)' in output
tests.name: test_an_arm_that_wrote_nothing_is_named
